title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1663 East Date Place in San Bernardino, California, as the "Dr. Margaret B. Hill Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 1663 East Date Place in San Bernardino, California, as the Dr. Margaret B. Hill Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a San Bernardino, California post office building after Dr. Margaret B. Hill.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1663 East Date Place in San Bernardino, California, the Dr. Margaret B. Hill Post Office Building. It changes only the official designation of the building and does not change how mail is handled there. The law was signed on November 25, 2024.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The designation took effect when the law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
